productOnPage.title: My First 100 Words (Digital)
productOnPage.author: Yoto Educational
productOnPage.description:
Yoto Says: A fun intro to common words in different languages, with accompanying images. From to ant to bee, learning languages has never been so much fun. Children can hear the words for their favourite things (such as ‘fire engine’ and ‘rainbow’) in five languages: French, German, Spanish, Italian and English. At the same time, an accompanying image is triggered on your Yoto Player’s display to help with learning.

Digital Card: Get instant access in the Yoto App when you buy this digital card. Play it anywhere using the app or link it to a Make Your Own Card for your kids to enjoy whenever they like. 
Find out more about digital Yoto Cards and how to gift them. Tracks included: My first 100 words in english House and home house castle door camera television radio balloon environment earth moon sun rainbow sunflower tree cactus food and drink orange lemon seo.title: My First 100 Words (Digital)
seo.description:
Yoto Says: A fun intro to common words in different languages, with accompanying images. From to ant to bee, learning languages has never been so much fun. Children can hear the words for their favourite things (such as ‘fire engine’ and ‘rainbow’) in five languages: French, German, Spanish, Italian and English. At the same time, an accompanying image is triggered on your Yoto Player’s display to help with learning.

Digital Card: Get instant access in the Yoto App when you buy this digital card. Play it anywhere using the app or link it to a Make Your Own Card for your kids to enjoy whenever they like. 
Find out more about digital Yoto Cards and how to gift them. Tracks included: My first 100 words in english, House and home, house, castle, door and more.
